result.brief: 通过线性探针定位视频扩散 Transformer 内部表征中的物理量，揭示物理信息在去噪过程中被主动构建、按 token 局部存储，并可作为引导向量改变生成输出。
result.reason: Probes internal representations of video diffusion transformers for physical quantities, showing physical info is constructed in activations and steerable—directly informs video world-model representation learning.
